svg.text: "You are a helpful assistant. What is the capital of France?" → tokenizer → 13 tokens, one row each (a vector of 1,024 numbers on the 0.8B):
← C = 12 rows go through prefill; the last one,
"?", goes through decode and yields "·Paris". (· is a space)

g.text: inner loop: one layer after another, left to right
one column = one set of weights,
read once per call, for every row
GPU, or the ANE for dense
outer loop: one decode step per new token, fed back as the next input
